benefits.title: Storage that stays tidy while you work

items.title: Find any file in seconds
items.text: Search by name, content or date, across every folder you own or share.

items.title: Share with a link, not an attachment

items.title: Work together in real time

items.title: Versions you can roll back

pricing.title: Storage that grows with you
pricing.note: Prices are placeholders. Start free and upgrade when you need more space.

items.q: How much space do I get for free?
items.a: The free plan includes 15 GB. You can earn more space by inviting teammates.
Yes. Mark folders for offline use and they sync again when you are back online.

items.q: What happens if I delete a file by mistake?
items.a: Deleted files stay in the trash for 30 days on free plans and 180 days on paid plans.

items.q: Can I password protect a shared link?
items.a: Yes, on Plus and Team plans. You can also set an expiry date for any link.

items.q: Which file types can I preview?
items.a: Documents, images, video, audio and PDFs open in the browser without downloading.
Files are encrypted in transit and at rest. Team plans add client side key controls.

items.q: Can I move files from another service?
items.a: Yes. The importer copies folders and files from common drives and keeps their structure.
Yes. Cancel from billing settings. Your files stay readable for 30 days after cancellation.
